attacks.claim_at_risk: One frozen comparison within the declared ticket and finite control population
attacks.method: Confirmed R0 PASS and both detached contract hashes, identical scientific contents between the reviewed proposed contract and the freeze, all eighteen source commitments, and absence of official fit, blind and scored directories at authorization. Pre-run learner invocations used synthetic inputs outside either panel.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Raw bitmap and one correctness bit are the device's task-facing inputs
attacks.method: Traced the train boundary to only the 64-bit tuple, emitted action and correctness bit. The order, true-label environment and altered coupling remain outside devices. The group search operates on anonymous counts with no rotation/shape labels, former clue, or topology. The blind phase checks only query inputs, validates fit release and constructs fresh devices from their exports. Score now verifies both fit and blind release and parent chain before accessing the test-key bytes; a synthetic early-score probe verified this guard.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Identity-disjoint and class-balanced raw bitmap and shape holdouts
attacks.method: An independent coordinate renderer reproduced all 768 bitmaps, SHA IDs, exact ordered streams and both keys. Independently established six styles and twelve rotation orbits, zero predecessor bitmap/support/orbit overlaps, only q0/q1 in train, and zero training ancestry for the four held E/F class orbits even when allowing reflections. Each primary style/turn/position regime/class cell contains eight images.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Identical authorized exposures with only registered rule/schedule changes
attacks.method: All eleven fits use the same 64 bitmaps, one action and one correctness receipt per image. The numeric group twin computes subset moments by a different procedure, with the same eligibility, class calibration, score, abstentions and tie rule. Both prior-model arms import the frozen ungrouped predecessor learner and start from neutral on the fresh ordinary stream. Shifted reward is a fixed rotation by seventeen labels in the unchanged bitmap stream, preserving balance. It is a matched pairing control, not a population randomization test.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Checks and blind output are separated from the fitting path
attacks.method: Reviewed exclusive-file and phase-directory creation, checked phase guard against changed checkpoint, missing seal and duplicate writes, and challenged malformed view records. The scorer refuses out-of-order access before opening the test key. Actual phase releases must be recorded externally by digest before their next phase to rule out joint replacement of release and outputs.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Training identifies a tied family of unordered count partitions
attacks.method: The current guess and binary correctness identify the rewarded action exactly. Constant total 81 makes a partition's complementary side equivalent when means are reflected. Independent enumeration checked all 65536 raw subsets and generated one member of each of 32767 eligible nonempty unordered partitions. Synthetic checks establish a genuine four-way infinite-rank tie, finite rank 1/7, midpoint abstention, final action-zero tie and empty no-separation family. Physical and numeric search both retained every maximizing candidate under arbitrary ID recoding.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Bounded one-pass fit budget and charged exhaustive search
attacks.method: Source caps every fitting arm at 64 scheduled acquisitions and runs 32767 candidate partitions after acquisition. A partition learner reserves 40494 independent addressed ternary holdings, including flag storage and cleared acquisition space, with temporary arithmetic only during computation. Physical and conventional readers have matched exposure. Prior arithmetic and storage differ and no compute/budget equality beyond one exposure is claimed. Releases retain actual time and high-water recording.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Registered exact subgroup threshold and explicit weighting
attacks.method: Score joins all 704 held bitmaps and tests above half separately in the specified sixteen eight-image primary cells per law. Each image has one vote within a cell; translated drawings can share all observed counts. Those translations do not form independent populations. Prior and selection-blind comparisons are reported separately from the gate.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Inference respects arbitrary bin IDs and holds geometry apart from selection
attacks.method: Five synthetic bitmap stencils matched independently reconstructed padded counts in both implementations. Compared all selected flags and abstaining or disagreeing votes under a fixed recoding that changes the side omitting bin 15. Source uses bin 15 only as complement reference with all cutoff ties retained, leaving no ordinal tie priority. Held turns and styles are certified by the independent census.

attacks.claim_at_risk: Used membership marks and calibration can be tested independently
attacks.method: On synthetic cases both actual ternary supports satisfy K1-K3 and admit exactly the executable full triples. Verified both-law physical-only transfer, erase and restore, and exact unchanged calibration bytes under flag-only erase. Ten malformed physical exports were rejected. Actual blind path also uses a fixed-calibration committee over every group at the selected size, reciprocal opposite donors, shams, full clearing and restoration. None alone asserts knot-specific superiority.
